name: issue-pr-review/regression-green-at-base
prompt: Auto mode: a bug PR cites a regression test that already passes at base; the review re-runs it red-at-base/green-at-head, reports the proof and the not_verified Sensitivity row, and never merges a PR without a red-to-green proof (#556)

grade.label: the fixture PR body is otherwise conforming
the cited regression test passes at base, so the proof is green at base
auto mode leaves open a bug PR whose regression test passes at base
a test red at base and green at head is the proof
a red-to-green proof meets the floor
a cited test with a :line suffix is run as its file
a red-to-green proof cited with a :line suffix meets the floor
auto mode leaves open a bug PR marked not reproduced
a bug PR with no Reproduction line counts as not reproduced
a cited test outside the PR's files is never run
an unsafe cited path is never run
a regression test red at head holds the floor
a base red from an import, not the test's assertion, is unproven
an unproven bug proof holds the floor
a non-bug issue has no proof to run
the proof clause leaves non-bug PRs to the criteria
an interactive run asks the maintainer instead of deciding
the review reads the Sensitivity rows and reports the not_verified one
the not_verified Sensitivity row is reported on a non-bug PR too
every base run leaves one worktree and an untouched PR checkout
the PR and issue were read once and the PR was never merged
review summary states result, evidence, uncertainty, and decision

criteria: The Evidence row reports the cited test's result at base and at head, with the test path.
The PR is left open because the merge floor is unmet, and the reason names the bug proof.
The Uncertainty row lists the criterion whose sensitivity was not verified, with its reason.
Nothing in the summary calls the PR merged or ready to merge.
human_review.feedback: Record each reviewer answer; absent, blank, or nonresponsive feedback leaves understanding unconfirmed.
human_review.scope: This deterministic stand-in runs the Bug proof procedure on a real git fixture with a fixture PR body; criteria are modelled as all pass so each floor decision isolates the proof clause. Apply these criteria to actual agent outputs in behavioral evaluations.
